title: Snow Shovel Without Battery – Clears 30 cm, Throws 8 m
seo_description: Battery-powered snow shovel, bare tool without battery and charger. Clearing width 30 cm, clearing depth 15 cm, throws the snow 8 meters. Fits Makita-type batteries.
descriptionHtml:
The snow came overnight again

At seven o'clock you're standing with the shovel in your hand and the driveway is white again. Your back is already protesting after the first stroke, and you know it will take a quarter of an hour just to get out to the car.

Push it in front of you instead of lifting

The snow shovel clears 30 cm wide and 15 cm deep in one sweep and throws the snow 8 meters to the side instead of leaving it in the way. It is delivered as a bare tool – battery and charger are not included, but it fits Makita-type batteries.

Features

  • Fits the battery you already have – compatible with Makita-type batteries. Battery and charger are not included.
  • Clears a wide strip in one sweep – clearing width 30 cm.
  • Takes 15 cm of snow in one pass – clearing depth 15 cm.
  • Throws the snow away from the path, not back onto it – throwing distance 8 meters.
  • No cord to drag out in the cold – battery-powered, no plug to look for.

Battery and charger are not included.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
